scope: SynthMorph registration and moved-image resampling through the linear interpolation path

pipeline: added an opt-in surfa_nearest_rule branch to _resampled_image
enabled that branch only inside apply_transform; SynthMorph.__call__ leaves it disabled
spatial: kept the affine dense calculation and linear interpolation branch unchanged
moved method validation before coordinate construction without changing valid linear calls

ast_check.normalization: specialize _resampled_image and spatial.transform to method=linear, remove invalid-method and nearest-output branches, and normalize the affine coordinate assignment to the unchanged dense call

nearest_semantics.implementation: apply_transform(method='nearest') uses Surfa 0.6.3 rules: floor(x + 0.5) and the valid coordinate domain [0, size)

status.interpretation: The real registration metrics and timings retain their measured source hashes and inherit only through the unchanged linear registration path. The nearest-neighbour branch has separate targeted tests and is not validated by the 12-case registration reports.

limits: This attestation does not turn the preserved reports into fresh current-source runs.
It does not claim that apply_transform(method='nearest') was compared on the 12 real registration cases.
It is restricted to the exact old and current source hashes listed above.
